title: Maintaining Optimal Drainage Slope
description: Proper pipe pitch is critical for maintaining self-scouring velocity inside drainage systems. If a drain line lacks sufficient slope, wastewater moves too slowly, leaving solid waste and grease behind to form stubborn clogs. Conversely, an excessive slope allows liquids to rush ahead of solids, leaving debris stranded inside the pipe. Routine maintenance involves checking drain hangers and structural supports for pipe sag, ensuring horizontal runs maintain a continuous grade toward the main stack. Inspecting pipe pitch prevents standing water, reduces line cleaning requirements, and extends the overall service life of the drainage network.
